newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: EDP share price seen at 1,900-2,600 esc.
newsitem.headline: EDP share price seen at 1,900-2,600 esc.

text.p: Analysts polled by Reuters said Portugal's cabinet was likely to fix the share price in the partial privatisation of utility EDP-Electricidade de Portugal at between 1,900 and 2,600 escudos.
The Socialist government is expected to sell off up to 30 percent of EDP in a special session on the Lisbon bourse next month.
"The final share price of EDP should stand at between 2,200 and 2,300 escudos, with the initial range probably between 2,100 and 2,400 escudos," said one analyst, who asked not to be identified.
Another said: "The spread should be between 2,000 and 2,500 escudos, with the final price around 2,300 escudos."

A third analyst said: "I hope that the price range will be fixed between 2,200 and 2,600 escudos. They are prices a little below the level of the valuation of EDP, but it is normal that the privatisation price should incorporate a discount to the valuation price."
EDP has been valued at between 1.4 and 1.7 trillion escudos.
The Portuguese cabinet is expected to set maximum and minimum prices next week in the partial privatisation of EDP, a source close to the process has said.
There are no rules for setting the prices, but in previous privatisations of Portugal Telecom and Portucel Industrial, the minimum price was around 25 percent below the maximum price.

The cabinet will set quantities to be sold in the public offer for sale (OPV) and the direct sale. The price in the OPV will be fixed at a level between the minimum and maximum prices by Under-Secretary for Finance Fernando Teixeira Santos on June 16, the date of the OPV.
